{{Top|leg}}
'''External control couplings''' connected the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] interface of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to the operating systems of a larger automated hulk, when the smaller ship was fitted inside the larger [[Drone barge/Legends|drone barge]] shell. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was fitted with external control couplings when it was secreted inside the robo-barge on its mission to [[Orron III]].
